    • Content: Features a special interview, never-before-seen archival footage, and recreated sets.
    • Australian Time: The special will be available around 6 p.m. AEDT on March 24. 
    The special was filmed in front of a live studio audience to honor the series that originally aired from 2006 to 2011.
